tests.name: Seminar: 1 <-> 2 <-> 3 <-> 4
Pop from both ends
prepend
tests.setup:
d = DoublyLinkedList()
d.append(2)
d.prepend(1)
d.append(3)
d.prepend(0)

tests.name: Emptying the list resets head and tail
tests.setup:
d = DoublyLinkedList()
d.append(1)
d.append(2)
d.pop_front()
d.pop_front()
tests.hint: When the last node is removed, both head and tail must become None.

tests.name: Reuse after emptying
tests.setup:
d = DoublyLinkedList()
d.append(1)
d.pop_back()
d.append(2)
d.prepend(1)
d.append(3)

tests.name: prev links after pops
tests.setup:
d = DoublyLinkedList()
for v in range(6):
    d.append(v)
d.pop_front()
d.pop_back()
tests.hint: After pop_front, the new head's prev must be None. After pop_back, the new tail's next must be None.

tests.name: Queue of 200 000
tests.setup:
d = DoublyLinkedList()
for v in range(200000):
    d.append(v)
out = [d.pop_front() for _ in range(199990)]
tests.hint: Every method except to_list must be O(1). Don't walk the list to find the tail.
